Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 19-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  SUBJECT: ELE 1003/ELE_1003 FUNDAMENTALS OF ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING  
  Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering [ELE 1003]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               For the circuit shown in the figure, determine current I0 using mesh current analysis. Also             (5)  
  determine the power delivered by 15V source.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
1B)               Find Thevenin's equivalent of the network across terminals A and B, what is the value maximum           (5)  
  power that can be transferred to variable load connected across A&B.  
  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2A)   The circuit shown below has achieved steady state when the switch is in position A. At t = 0 s,         (4)  
  switch is moved to position B. Write the expression for voltage across the capacitor for t > 0 and find  
  $$its value at t = 5 ms.$$  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2B)   The circuit shown below has a 230 V, 50 Hz source. If the current through a 0.05 H inductor is 3.5      (6)  
  ∠-800 , taking supply voltage as the reference,  
  i) Find the value of 'R' and 'C'.  
  ii) Determine the power factor of the circuit.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3A)   The following loads are connected in parallel across a 230 V, 50 Hz, single-phase ac supply.            (4)  
  i) 250 VA, 0.5 p.f lagging  
  ii) 300 VA, 100 VAR (inductive)  
  
  a) Obtain the complete power triangle.  
  b) Calculate the capacitance required in parallel with the loads to raise power factor = 1.  
  c) Both the loads are ON for 8 hours a day over a 30-day month. If the energy tariff is ₹6.00 per  
  kWh. Calculate the monthly energy charges.  
  
  Page #2

Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3B)   A 3-phase, 415 V, RYB, 50 Hz balanced AC supply is connected to an unbalanced delta connected (6)  
  load as shown in the circuit.  
  If                                                                       then  
  
  i) Find the value of all the impedances in ohms.  
  ii) Total power consumed by the load.Sketch the phasor diagram clearly showing line voltages, line  
  & phase currents. Take VRY as reference.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4A)   A ring made of ferromagnetic material has a cross-sectional area of 400 mm², with inner and outer        (4)  
  radii of 60 mm and 70 mm, respectively. The core is uniformly wound with a coil of 1000 turns.  
  Determine the relative permeability of the ring if a current of 5 A produces a flux of 1 mWb in an air  
  gap of length 2 mm.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4B)   What are the different losses that occur in an induction motor? Why are starters necessary for           (3)  
  induction motors? Explain why single-phase induction motors are not self-starting.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4C)   Explain any three renewable energy systems used for power generation, highlighting their key             (3)  
  features and components.  
  
  
  Page #3

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5A)                   List the main components of a digital measuring instrument and describe their functions.              (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5B)                   Compare a Linear Power Supply and a Switched Mode Power Supply (SMPS) in terms of their               (3)  
  design, efficiency and applications.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5C)                   List the classification of power electronic converters and briefly explain one example in each.       (4)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
